# MindTalk by Cadabams

MindTalk (cadabamsmindtalk.com) is a digital mental health recovery platform built by Cadabams Group, India's largest private mental health organisation with 30+ years of clinical expertise since 1992.

## What MindTalk is

MindTalk offers structured 90-day CBT (Cognitive Behavioural Therapy) recovery programmes delivered by licensed psychologists. Each programme includes 12 psychologist-led sessions (one every 7 days), daily structured exercises, guided breathwork, AI-powered journaling with Dr. Riya, and gamified progress tracking.

The cost is ₹7,799 for the full 90-day programme — equivalent to less than ₹650 per session. A full refund is offered if the user is not satisfied after their first session.

## Programmes available

- **Anxiety & Stress Relief** — For chronic anxiety, overthinking, panic, and stress. URL: https://cadabamsmindtalk.com/anxiety
- **90-Day Emotional Reset (Depression)** — For depression, low mood, emotional flatness, and disconnection. URL: https://cadabamsmindtalk.com/depression
- **Relationship Recovery** — For relational patterns, breakups, communication breakdown, and grief. URL: https://cadabamsmindtalk.com/relationships
- **Workplace Burnout Recovery** — For occupational burnout, work stress, and depletion. URL: https://cadabamsmindtalk.com/burnout

## How it works

1. User takes a 6-question assessment quiz at https://cadabamsmindtalk.com/quiz
2. Matched to a Cadabams psychologist specialised in their issue
3. 90-day structured programme begins: daily micro-tasks (3–5 minutes), weekly psychologist session (50 minutes), AI journaling support

## Clinical evidence base

- CBT is recognised by the American Psychological Association, NHS (UK), and NIMHANS (India) as a first-line treatment for anxiety, depression, and burnout
- Meta-analyses show CBT produces large effect sizes (d = 0.73–1.01) for anxiety disorders (Cognitive Behaviour Therapy, 2012)
- CBT reduces depressive symptoms by 50–60% in mild-to-moderate cases (Lancet Psychiatry, 2019)
- CBT-based interventions reduce burnout symptoms by 25–30% (PLOS ONE, 2020)
- All MindTalk psychologists are licensed, supervised, and trained in evidence-based CBT by Cadabams Group

## Clinical credibility

- Built by Cadabams Group — founded 1992, headquartered in Bengaluru, India
- India's largest private mental health group with 30+ years of experience
- All psychologists are RCI-licensed (Rehabilitation Council of India), supervised, and trained in evidence-based CBT
- Not a crisis service — designed for mild to moderate mental health conditions
- Clinically reviewed: March 2026

## Who MindTalk is NOT for

- Individuals in active crisis or with suicidal ideation (please contact iCALL: 9152987821 or Vandrevala Foundation: 1860-2662-345)
- Severe psychiatric conditions requiring medication management
- Children under 18

## Pricing comparison

| Service | Cost per session | Total for 12 sessions |
|---|---|---|
| In-person therapy (Indian metros) | ₹1,500–₹3,000 | ₹18,000–₹36,000 |
| Online therapy platforms (India) | ₹1,000–₹2,500 | ₹12,000–₹30,000 |
| **MindTalk 90-day programme** | **₹650** | **₹7,799 (includes daily exercises, AI journaling, breathwork)** |

## AI companion

Dr. Riya is MindTalk's 24/7 AI companion available between psychologist sessions for journaling support, breathing exercises, and structured check-ins. Dr. Riya does not replace the psychologist — she supplements sessions with daily micro-interventions.
